## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector participation (Real Estate/Utilities/Materials strong) and significant weakness in Technology and Financials; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate in Top 5), so no clear directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate lead: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%). Utilities strong: EXC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%), AEP ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%). Materials showing strength: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: BAC CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%), C BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%). Technology weak: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%). Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%), TSLA POTENTIAL REVERSAL -> RECOVERY mapping (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -4.95%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), CCI ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%), TMUS ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate) — cyclical/income concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BAC CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +12.74%), AMT (1W: +12.16%), ORCL (1W: +12.13%), CCI (1W: +11.75%), TMUS (1W: +11.20%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap names (ORCL, EL, MSFT, BAC, CSCO) show 1W vs 1M disagreement — tactical moves, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed/weak; several bellwethers BELOW TREND. AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -12.64%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%), CSCO CORRECTION mapping (1W: -9.40% | 1M: +3.28%). Sector result: internal rotation and dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft and fragmented; large banks under pressure. JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%), BAC CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%). Sector showing weakness and risk to credit/cash flow narratives.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed with defensive pockets but headline legal/news risks. JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) and PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +9.62%) contrast with LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%); sector displays rotation into select names, breadth modestly mixed.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, favor exposure to Real Estate/Utilities/Materials names showing ABOVE TREND strength and reduce exposure to weak Tech and Financial names until breadth widens; Style: mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor RECOVERY names (ORCL, MSFT) for follow‑through before treating moves as durable.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%), AMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%). BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Real Estate (Breadth: sector positive; leaders ABOVE TREND), Utilities (leaders ABOVE TREND), Materials (strength in miners). BEARISH: Technology (sector negative), Financials (sector negative), Consumer Discretionary (weak).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for confirmation above recent 1W highs for EQIX/AMT to validate leadership; a sustained break below this week’s lows for AAPL and INTC would reinforce tech downside; ORCL follow‑through above this week’s gap would validate RECOVERY moves.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
EXC (+60): Q4 beat and strategic commentary — price confirming (EXC ABOVE TREND: 1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%). EL (+60): raised 2026 guidance — price diverging into short-term RECOVERY setup but 1M negative prior (EL RECOVERY: 1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%). EQIX (+55): AI-driven results and outlook — price confirming (EQIX ABOVE TREND: 1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-45): negative take on EV strategy — price mixed but TSLA RECOVERY mapping (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -4.95%) so sentiment could pressure follow‑through. BA (-45): execution/union risk — BA TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +0.14%), news aligns with cautious positioning. JNJ (-45): talc verdict headlines — JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) so legal headlines are a divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Real Estate concentration and mixed sector breadth. EQIX, AMT, CCI showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, INTC, major banks are showing weakness (BELOW TREND/CORRECTION). Key risk: MAJOR divergence across several large caps (ORCL, MSFT, BAC, CSCO) and headline legal/news items (JNJ, TSLA) — watch for confirmation before reallocating core exposures.
